BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

4. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

5. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

6. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

7. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.

8. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.

11. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

12. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

13. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.

14. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.

15. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.

16. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
